Title: Líder de Analítica de Datos/Gestión de Riesgos
Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting, Wholesale Building Materials, and Wholesale Chemical and Allied Products
Description: Empresa líder en soluciones para la industria de la construcción busca Líder de Analítica de Datos/Gestión de Riesgos , responsable de liderar iniciativas de análisis de datos orientadas a la identificación de riesgos, oportunidades de mejora y generación de información estratégica, transformando grandes volúmenes de datos en insights que faciliten la toma de decisiones y fortalezcan la eficiencia de los procesos organizacionales. Zona laboral: Santa Catarina, NL. Propósito de la posición: Implementar esquemas de monitoreo continuo que permitan detectar desviaciones y riesgos oportunamente. Así como desarrollar capacidades analíticas dentro del equipo y promover una cultura basada en datos. Principales funciones: Diseñar e implementar modelos de análisis para identificar tendencias, riesgos y oportunidades de mejora. Desarrollar tableros, reportes e indicadores para el seguimiento de procesos clave. Analizar grandes volúmenes de información provenientes de diversas fuentes y sistemas. Liderar proyectos de automatización y optimización de procesos mediante el uso de tecnología y analítica avanzada. Coordinarse con diferentes áreas para entender necesidades de información y traducirlas en soluciones analíticas. Presentar hallazgos y recomendaciones a líderes y tomadores de decisión. Gestionar estándares de calidad, integridad y gobierno de datos. Principales requerimientos: Formación: Licenciatura terminada y titulada en Informática / TI, Ciencia de Datos o Actuaría (también se consideran Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística o Contaduría con especialización en datos). Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en analítica de datos, de los cuales al menos 2 en auditoría interna/externa, riesgos, control interno o cumplimiento. Experiencia en monitoreo continuo, detección de fraude o forensic analytics. - Disponibilidad de viajar ocasionalmente. Conocimientos/habilidades: - Dominio demostrable de SQL y de al menos un lenguaje analítico (Python o R). - Dominio de una herramienta de visualización (Power BI, Tableau o similar). - Conocimiento de procesos de negocio y de datos en ERP (SAP, Oracle u otro). - Experiencia comunicando resultados a nivel directivo. - Inglés intermedio-avanzado para lectura técnica y estándares. Softskills: - Comunicación efectiva - Pensamiento analítico - Liderazgo - Orientación a resultados

En Principal creemos que el futuro financiero se construye con decisiones informadas y centradas en las personas. Diseñar dashboards, KPIs y modelos de datos, así como automatizar procesos analíticos y de reportería, entendiendo y aterrizando las necesidades del negocio. Licenciatura o ingeniería en Actuaría, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Finanzas, Sistemas, Ciencia de Datos, Negocios o área afín. 3 a 5 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, Analytics, Data Analysis o posiciones relacionadas. Experiencia con Power BI (deseable), SQL, DAX, Power Query y Excel avanzado. Conocimientos de modelado y transformación de datos, estadística descriptiva e inferencial, pruebas de hipótesis y diseño de experimentos. R y/o Python deseable, así como conocimientos de Azure, automatización e IA aplicada. Inglés intermedio Nuestra Cultura de Trabajo Somos conscientes que un adecuado equilibrio es la mejor forma de tener equipos exitosos y empoderados, por lo cual adoptamos un enfoque de flexibilidad que se adapta a tus necesidades y de tu equipo con base en una cultura de confianza. Nuestro compromiso es entregarte los recursos y oportunidades que necesitas para ser exitoso. ¿Qué podemos ofrecerte? ¡Flexibilidad! Modalidad de Trabajo híbrido con vestimenta flexible y espacios colaborativos. Más tiempo para ti: los viernes trabajamos hasta las 3:00 p.m. y además podrás tener días adicionales a tus vacaciones al año. Un paquete de Compensación Integral con prestaciones superiores a la ley y beneficios que promueven tu seguridad financiera, como: SGMM, seguro de vida, plan privado de pensión, programa de compra de acciones, vales de despensa, una app de consultas ilimitadas con médicos, nutriólogos y psicólogos, etc. Oportunidades y herramientas para impulsar tu desarrollo profesional. Title: ANALISTA DE DATOS
Location: Villa de García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Descripción de puesto Responsable del diseño, desarrollo, automatización y liberación de soluciones digitales, aplicaciones y tableros web, integraciones, automatizaciones y modelos analíticos que aseguran la continuidad de la operación y habilitan la toma de decisiones del equipo comercial del área. Principales responsabilidades Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones y plataformas web internas (frontend y backend) para la gestión comercial de la VP. Modelar, administrar y optimizar bases de datos, así como construir procesos de extracción, transformación y carga (ETL) de información. Desarrollar e implementar automatizaciones e integraciones entre sistemas que sustituyan procesos manuales y aseguren la continuidad operativa. Diseñar e implementar motores de cálculo y modelos de pronóstico y analítica de datos. Desarrollar, integrar y publicar tableros web y reportes embebidos dentro de las plataformas del área. Garantizar la calidad, las pruebas, el control de versiones y el despliegue (CI/CD) de las soluciones liberadas a producción. Colaborar con las demás áreas del negocio para traducir necesidades operativas en soluciones técnicas escalables. Retos del puesto Traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones técnicas escalables y mantenibles. Trabajo bajo presión y conflicto de prioridades, atendiendo de forma simultánea a las 4 regiones. Asegurar la continuidad operativa y la disponibilidad de los sistemas en producción. Desarrollar nuevos mecanismos y entregables en los tiempos requeridos. Habilidades y conocimientos requeridos Escolaridad: Ingeniero en Sistemas / Ciencias Computacionales, Lic. en Tecnologías de la Información o afín. Dominio del idioma inglés (técnico). Programación full stack (indispensable: desarrollo backend y frontend). Lenguaje de programación SQL y modelado de bases de datos relacionales. Diseño de soluciones, automatizaciones e integraciones entre sistemas. Power BI (desarrollo de tableros, deseable). Experiencia requerida 2-3 años en desarrollo de software / aplicaciones web. 2-3 años en manejo y modelado de bases de datos. Experiencia comprobable en automatización de procesos. Conocimiento requerido Desarrollo de software: Python (Django / REST APIs) JavaScript / TypeScript (React) Diseño e integración de APIs REST Bases de datos: SQL — PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Azure Diseño, modelado y optimización de bases de datos Automatización e integración: Servicios y scripts de automatización Power Automate, Power Apps Data y analítica: Análisis y modelado de datos (incluye pronósticos / ML) Power BI (incluye reportes embebidos) Control de versiones y despliegue: Git, CI/CD Excel: Avanzado Relaciones NA Diversidad e Inclusión en CEMEX En CEMEX, reconocemos la diversidad del mundo en el que vivimos y en el que hacemos negocios. Respetamos la diversidad, abordamos la inclusión y la no-discriminación de cualquier persona con talento, independientemente de su género, capacidad física, edad, orientación sexual, cultura, origen étnico, religión, afiliación política, estado civil, embarazo/maternidad/paternidad y nacionalidad. Promovemos una cultura de equidad para la construcción de un negocio sostenible y el bienestar y desarrollo de los colaboradores de CEMEX.

Title: (CEN) GLOBAL DATA SCIENCE INTERN
Description: Name of the Project: Global Data Science Intern Vice Presidency: Digital Enablement Region: Central Intern’s Location (Office): Campus CX Eligible Semester(s): 5th - 8th semester Careers of Interest: Data Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Actuarial, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, Artificial Intelligence Engineering Schedule Availability: Between 25 and 30 hours per week Period of Stay at CEMEX: 6 months, with the option of renewal Tentative Start Date: October 2026 Project Objective Actively contribute to the development of end‑to‑end analytical solutions for real business use cases in the Supply Chain domain, covering the full lifecycle from data exploration and modeling to production deployment and result consumption, with technical mentorship and guidance from the Global Data Science team. Challenges for the Students Understanding and translating real business problems into data driven solutions. Working with complex, large scale datasets and ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability. Generating tangible business value. Developing analytical solutions that go beyond experimentation, considering scalability, maintainability, and usability. Collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary, global team and adapting to agile ways of working. Applying modern data science best practices, including reproducibility, documentation, and code quality. Learning and using an enterprise grade data science stack Main Responsibilities And Activities To Be Carried Out Process, clean, and validate data, ensuring data quality and reliability for analytical and modeling purposes. Conduct exploratory data analysis to generate insights and support decision‑making through analytical outputs and visualizations. Formulate hypotheses, design analytical approaches, and apply statistical techniques to validate results. Perform feature engineering and data preparation to support predictive and prescriptive modeling efforts. Develop, evaluate, and iterate on predictive or prescriptive models using machine learning or other advanced AI techniques. Contribute to the full lifecycle of Data Science solutions, including documentation, validation, and preparation for production deployment. Apply Data Science and Software Engineering best practices, including reproducibility, version control, and clear technical documentation. Required Specific Requirements / Qualifications Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to break down complex business problems into structured analytical tasks. Proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, reusable, and well structured code for data analysis and modeling. Solid knowledge of SQL. Ability to communicate insights effectively through data storytelling, using clear analysis and visual outputs. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively within a team oriented, agile environment. High level of attention to detail and a structured approach to problem solving. English proficiency sufficient for technical and professional communication in a global team. Familiarity with version control tools (e.g., Git). Nice to Have Familiarity with Snowflake or other analytical data warehouses. Knowledge of web applications development REST APIs, HTML and/or CSS. Knowledge or practical experience in simulation techniques (e.g., discrete‑event simulation, Monte Carlo simulation). Knowledge or practical experience in optimization methods, such as linear, integer, or nonlinear optimization, heuristics, or metaheuristics. Familiarity with optimization or simulation libraries/tools (e.g., OR‑Tools, PuLP, Gurobi, CPLEX, SimPy, or similar). Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Exposure to AI models beyond academic coursework. Experience working with enterprise grade data platforms or cloud based analytical environments. (Azure, AWS, etc.)

Title: Private Capital Data Operations & AI Innovation Associate
Description: Your Team Responsibilities Make an Impact at the Intersection of Financial Data, Technology & InnovationAbout the Team & Opportunity Are you passionate about financial data, energized by solving complex challenges, and excited about how AI is transforming the way we work? Join MSCI's Private Capital Solutions (PCS) team, where you'll play a key role in delivering the high-quality financial data that powers critical investment decisions for clients across the private capital industry. Our team sits at the intersection of financial expertise, cutting-edge technology, and client experience . We transform complex financial information into accurate, reliable, and actionable data, leveraging advanced technology, AI-powered tools, and strong analytical expertise to deliver exceptional results. In this role, you'll do more than oversee operations. You'll have the opportunity to lead improvements, influence how we work, solve meaningful client challenges, and help shape the future of AI-enabled financial data operations at MSCI. You'll collaborate with talented professionals across Data Operations, Product, Engineering, and Client Service, bringing together different perspectives to continuously improve our processes, strengthen data quality, and deliver an outstanding client experience. If you enjoy combining analytical thinking, technology, leadership, and continuous improvement, this is an opportunity to make a real impact. https://careers.msci.com/life-at-msci Your Key Responsibilities What You'll Do Drive Operational Excellence & Client Impact Take ownership of critical financial data operations, ensuring our Private Capital Solutions clients receive accurate, timely, and high-quality data. Be the go-to expert for complex client data challenges, using your analytical skills and problem-solving mindset to deliver effective solutions. Monitor operational performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and help the team consistently exceed quality and service expectations. Shape the Future of AI-Powered Data Operations Work hands-on with AI-enabled financial data extraction and validation tools, combining technology with human expertise to deliver reliable results. Help define what great data quality looks like by establishing quality benchmarks, strengthening validation frameworks, and ensuring transparency and auditability. Investigate complex data exceptions, uncover root causes, and develop sustainable solutions that improve accuracy and reduce recurring issues. Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, streamline workflows, and unlock new efficiencies through technology and innovation. Collaborate, Influence & Innovate Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, and Client Service teams to solve challenges and improve the end-to-end client data experience. Turn operational insights and client feedback into meaningful recommendations that influence technology enhancements, workflows, and service improvements. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen data quality, operational controls, scalability, and overall team performance. Play an active role in evolving our financial data processes as new technologies and business needs emerge. Lead, Develop & Inspire Others Act as a trusted subject matter expert in private capital financial data, operational workflows, and AI-assisted data validation. Mentor and support Analysts and Associates, sharing your expertise, strengthening technical capabilities, and helping others grow. Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning. Use performance insights, KPIs, and operational analytics to identify trends, communicate results, and help drive informed decisions. Why This Role Matters Financial data is at the heart of the decisions our clients make every day. Your work will directly contribute to the accuracy, reliability, and scalability of the data services they depend on. This is an opportunity to combine your financial and analytical expertise with emerging AI technologies, collaborate with teams across MSCI, and help build smarter, more efficient ways of working. If you're someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving challenging problems, developing others, and turning ideas into meaningful improvements, we'd love to hear from you. Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel What You'll Bring to the Team We're looking for a curious, analytical, and solutions-oriented professional who thrives on solving complex challenges, embraces new technologies, and is passionate about making financial data smarter, more accurate, and more impactful. You'll be successful in this role if you bring a combination of financial expertise, technological curiosity, strong problem solving skills and a collaborative mindset. A strong foundation in finance and data: A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Science, or a related field. At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in financial data operations, data management, client data services, or a similar financial services environment. A passion for AI and emerging technologies: Hands-on experience using AI-powered data extraction and validation tools, with the analytical judgment to challenge outputs, identify inconsistencies, and ensure data accuracy and reliability. A natural problem-solving mindset: You enjoy getting to the root of complex issues, navigating ambiguity, and turning operational challenges into opportunities for smarter, more efficient ways of working. The ability to connect people, processes, and technology: Experience driving cross-functional initiatives and building strong relationships with Technology, Product, Operations, and client-facing teams to deliver meaningful improvements. The confidence to communicate and influence: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial data concepts, share insights, and engage stakeholders across different levels and functions. An uncompromising commitment to quality: A sharp eye for detail and a disciplined approach to data integrity, quality assurance, operational controls, and auditability, including within AI-assisted workflows. An understanding of private markets: Knowledge of private capital data, fund administration, investment operations, or related financial datasets, and an interest in how high-quality data supports investment decisions. A technology-driven approach to efficiency: Experience working with financial data pipelines, workflow automation or orchestration tools, and cloud-based data environments, with an eagerness to explore better ways of working. A collaborative leadership style: Experience mentoring or guiding junior colleagues, sharing knowledge, encouraging continuous learning, and helping build a high-performing team. What Will Make You Stand Out Beyond your technical experience, we value individuals who bring curiosity, initiative, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset . You're someone who doesn't just identify problems, you take ownership of solving them. You're excited about the potential of AI, comfortable challenging existing processes, and motivated by opportunities to make a tangible impact. If you're ready to combine your financial expertise with innovation, collaboration, and meaningful problem-solving, we'd love to hear from you! A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results. A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients. Title: Data Engineer
Description: Descripción: Somos una consultora con más de 20 años en el mercado que hacemos desde BI, AI, desarrollo a la medida, machine learning. Somos socios fundadores del CIIA Centro de Inteligencia Artificial y contamos con más de 50 clientes a nivel nacional y uno de nuestros clientes muy reconocido a nivel nacional nos está solicitando este perfil como Data Engineer Actividades: Más de 5 años de experiencia en modelado de datos analítico/dimensional en entornos Cloud. Experiencia comprobada modelando en Snowflake, incluyendo: Advanced Schemas Views y Secure Views Dynamic Tables Materialized Views Clustering Keys Optimización de modelos para consumo masivo. Certificación Snowflake (SnowPro Core como mínimo; SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer o Architect altamente valorada). Habilidad demostrada para facilitar conversaciones de negocio, entrevistar usuarios, identificar entidades, relaciones y métricas, y formalizar requerimientos ambiguos en modelos lógicos claros. Experiencia diseñando y gestionando capas semánticas: Métricas reutilizables Dimensiones conformadas Jerarquías Reglas de agregación Single Source of Truth para reporting. Dominio de Power BI: DAX Modelado tabular Diseño de reportes Conexiones DirectQuery e Import con Snowflake Publicación y administración de datasets. SQL avanzado para: Desarrollo y optimización de consultas complejas. Transformaciones de datos. Debug y análisis de performance mediante Query Profile en Snowflake. Requisitos: Nivel de Inglés avanzado Diseñar e implementar modelos de datos dimensionales y analíticos en Snowflake (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema y Data Vault 2.0, según el caso de uso). Liderar sesiones de descubrimiento con stakeholders de negocio para entender KPIs, métricas, reglas de negocio y jerarquías, traduciéndolas en estructuras de datos formales. Construir y mantener la capa semántica que abstraiga la complejidad técnica y permita a usuarios de negocio consumir datos con autonomía mediante herramientas como Snowflake Semantic Layer, dbt Semantic Layer, AtScale o similares. Definir nomenclaturas, estándares de modelado, documentación de linaje y diccionarios de datos como activos gobernados. Desarrollar y optimizar dashboards en Power BI conectados a Snowflake, asegurando rendimiento, claridad visual y alineación con los modelos semánticos definidos. Explorar e implementar Snowflake Cortex Agents y funcionalidades de Cortex AI para habilitar consultas en lenguaje natural, búsqueda semántica y asistentes conversacionales sobre los datos modelados. Colaborar con equipos de Ingeniería, Arquitectura y Gobierno de Datos para asegurar consistencia entre la capa de ingestión y la capa de consumo. Beneficios: Prestaciones de ley Exelente ambiente laboral Exelente horario Esquema 100% nomina

Title: Marketplace Operations Manager

Title: Senior Private AI Platform Lead (MLOps / AI Infrastructure & Agent Systems)
Description: Company: Unilink Transportation Time zone: You'll work US Central hours. Engagement: Full-time employee / ON SITE POSITION / SAN PEDRO GARZA GARCIA NL Reports to: CIO ABOUT THE ROLE We've decided to run our own AI, and we mean all of it. That means our own hardware in our own datacenter, with nothing going out to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or anyone else. Our data stays with us, it never ends up in someone else's training set. We need one experienced person to make this happen. You'll design it, build it, lock it down and run it in production. Then you'll write things up well enough that our IT team can keep it running without calling you. This isn't an advisory role. You'll rack the server, write the Ansible, tune vLLM and ship the agent platform yourself. A part-time DevOps/security engineer will join you for the network and hardening work, and you'll set their priorities. There are three pieces to the job: Stand up a private LLM platform on a new Lenovo GPU server with six NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell cards (576 GB of VRAM, with room for two more cards later). Build our own autonomous agent platform, similar to Manus. Someone on our team describes what they need in plain English. The agent makes a plan, uses a browser, runs code, works with files and talks to our internal systems inside a safe sandbox. Then it hands back a finished report, spreadsheet, script or completed workflow. Move our existing internal apps (about 20 of them) off outside AI APIs and off the GPU server we currently rent, onto our own internal endpoints. WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH Here's the AI we already run today. It's what you'll inherit and migrate: A finance and treasury analytics app where people ask questions in plain language. An operations analytics hub with its own AI analyst. An email assistant that sorts, drafts and summarizes mail for more than 70 mailboxes. It runs Mistral Small 24B on vLLM on a rented 24 GB GPU, and falls back to an external API when it needs to. A Microsoft Teams bot that lets staff ask the finance and operations AI questions in chat. A support assistant that answers IT questions from our ticketing knowledge base, with sources (pgvector embeddings). Playwright agents that work in our customers' freight portals, and an AI-driven sales outreach agent. Data sources: a PostgreSQL datalake on Aiven, McLeod TMS, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, n8n workflows, Pipedrive and our own REST APIs. The rest of the stack: Next.js and TypeScript, Node.js, Python (FastAPI and Flask), PostgreSQL, Docker and systemd, with apps hosted on Vercel, Render and our own Linux servers. WHAT YOU'LL DO Leading the program Own the plan from start to finish. That covers the architecture, milestones, approval gates, risks and regular updates to leadership. Write the architecture and security design, plus a sizing report for the hardware, and get both signed off before the build starts. Point the part-time DevOps/security engineer at the right work, and keep our IT, network and app teams in the loop. Keep a list of every component and model we use, along with its license, so we know we're allowed to use all of it commercially. 1. Bringing up the GPU server Install Ubuntu, the NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, Docker with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and the systemd services everything runs under. Set up monitoring and alerts (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry and GPU dashboards). Also set up backups, and actually test a restore. Come to San Antonio for the physical install, check power and network, and be there for first boot. 2. Serving the models Pick, install and tune open-weight models such as Qwen3, Mistral and Llama, using vLLM or SGLang. Use Ollama or llama.cpp where they make more sense. Open to other models - must prove customization experience. Spread large models across several GPUs, quantize them (AWQ, GPTQ, FP8, NVFP4) and run several models side by side without them fighting over memory. Put an OpenAI-compatible gateway in front of everything. It should let us pick the right model for each kind of task and swap models without downtime. An outside API is only ever used if we switch that on. Meet clear targets for concurrent users, time to first token and throughput. 3. Fine-tuning, search and evaluation Fine-tune models on our own data with LoRA or QLoRA, but only where it clearly helps. Build the embedding and vector search pipelines so models can answer from our own documents and show where each answer came from. Build a set of test tasks taken from our real work, and measure honestly how well the system does against our goals. 4. Building the agent platform Start from open-source projects like OpenManus, AI Manus or OpenHands where their licenses allow, or build from scratch if that's the better call. The agent should show its plan, work through it step by step, change course when something fails, and ask the user when it's stuck. Give each task its own throwaway sandbox (a container or micro-VM using gVisor, Kata or Firecracker) with a shell, Python, Node and a file system. When the task is done, the sandbox gets deleted or archived. Run a real Chromium browser inside the sandbox. Users can watch it live and take over if they want. Let the agent write and run code, install packages from our internal mirror, crunch spreadsheets, draw charts and produce files people can download (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, Markdown, HTML and code). Let it search the web through a provider we choose, and search our own documents too. Connect it to our ERP/TMS, CRM, ticketing, email and databases through MCP servers and REST connectors, with permissions set per tool. Build a simple web app where people can follow the plan, the steps, the browser and the output files, look back through old tasks and share them with colleagues. Add memory for each person and team, reusable task templates, scheduled tasks, and a documented API so our other apps can hand work to the agent. Make sure tasks survive restarts and can pick up where they left off. Each task also needs limits on time, tokens and compute. 5. Environments and deployment Set up separate sandbox, staging and production environments, with a clear process for promoting models and settings from one to the next. Define everything as code (Ansible, Helm and/or Terraform). Run the sandboxes and services on Kubernetes or something equivalent we agree on. Keep all storage in house (object storage, PostgreSQL and a vector database), and back all of it up. 6. Security and privacy (built in from day one, not bolted on at the end) The inference servers get no internet access at all. Agent sandboxes only get out through a proxy that logs everything and follows allow and deny lists. Whether the agent can browse the internet at all is a switch we control. Sign-in through Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory (OIDC or SAML), with role-based access. Keep secrets in a vault such as HashiCorp Vault and inject them only when a call needs them. The model never sees credentials, and they never land in a sandbox. Treat anything that comes from a web page, a file or an email as untrusted. That's our main defense against prompt injection. Encrypt data in transit and at rest, keep each user's data separate, and put clear retention and deletion rules in place. Keep a tamper-proof log of every task, tool call, command, URL and file, and make it possible to send it to a SIEM. Have the sandbox, the proxy and the login flow security-reviewed and penetration-tested before launch, and fix whatever turns up. 7. Migrating our existing apps Move our current AI apps onto the new internal endpoints one at a time. For each one, compare quality and keep a way to roll back. Once everything has moved, shut down the rented GPU server and retire the outside API keys. 8. Handing over and running it Write the runbooks our admins will rely on: deploying, upgrading, scaling, backup and restore, swapping a model and handling incidents. Also write a plain guide for everyday users. Train our IT team and our first group of users. Support the platform after launch, and keep owning it from then on. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER 6 MONTHS Staging and production run entirely in our datacenter, and they keep working with the internet unplugged. Every existing AI app has moved over, we've stopped paying for outside AI APIs, and the rented GPU is gone. The agent finishes [X]% of our [N] test tasks start to finish without anyone stepping in, and it handles [N] sessions at once. We can see exactly what the agent did, for any user and any task. Our IT team can deploy, update, scale, monitor and swap models from your runbooks without needing you. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 7+ years in infrastructure, platform or backend engineering, with at least 3 of those years spent hands-on with ML or LLM systems in production. You've self-hosted open-weight LLMs on multi-GPU NVIDIA servers using vLLM, SGLang, TGI or similar, including tensor parallelism, quantization and performance tuning. You've shipped at least one real LLM agent that uses tools, and you can show us a demo or put us in touch with a reference. You know Linux well: Ubuntu, NVIDIA drivers and CUDA, Docker, systemd, networking and storage. You've run Kubernetes, and you know how to safely run code you don't trust (gVisor, Kata, Firecracker or similar). You've done browser automation with Playwright, Puppeteer, Browser Use or something like it. You write solid Python and/or TypeScript, and you can put together a decent web UI. You understand security for multi-user systems, including SSO/OIDC, RBAC, network segmentation, egress control, secrets and audit logging. You've built RAG pipelines with embeddings and a vector database (pgvector or similar). You use infrastructure as code (Ansible, Terraform and/or Helm) and CI/CD as a matter of habit. You've led a technical project from start to finish. That means planning, writing the design, managing risk, and explaining progress to people who aren't engineers. You write clear English. Whoever comes after you will depend on your docs. You can travel to San Antonio, TX when needed. NICE TO HAVE You've contributed to, or run in production, OpenManus, OpenHands, AI Manus or a similar agent framework. You've built MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or integrated with enterprise systems. You've fine-tuned models with LoRA or QLoRA using PyTorch and Hugging Face. You've worked in on-premises or air-gapped environments, and you've racked GPU servers from Lenovo, Dell, Supermicro or HPE yourself. You've worked with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Microsoft Graph or Teams bots. You know your way around ISO 27001 or SOC 2 controls. You've worked in logistics or transportation, or with a TMS like McLeod.
